mentions.name: logprox
mentions.description: A logging proxy that traces where internal-to-external network calls originate and can optionally block them. The author also plans work on easing integration and deployment for anyone who wants to use it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an idea for a logging proxy to track down where internal->external calls are coming from and optionally block them.
